label: the r-forms: reph above the line and rakaar below it
note: Untaught, and it now blocks a named word rather than only a class of them. The reph and the rakaar do not look like a virama join at all, so the conjunct principle does not transfer to them by itself. The rakaar has been SHOWN since chapter 18 -- mitra is spelled with one -- and never named; the reph appears in paryant, which MR-A1-P-05 is waiting for. Two script lessons close this point and that point together.
